contexts.text: EVOLVE LEVEL 2, Audioscript for Unit 10 Quiz A Mr. Peters: Hi there, Tomas. So, today is your first day at the call center. Are you nervous? Tomas: No, not at all, Mr. Peters. Where would you like me to sit? Mr. Peters: OK. I'll show you to your seat in a moment, but first I just want to tell you about some office rules. Tomas: OK, sure. Mr. Peters: Now, you know what you have to do in your job, don't you? Tomas: Yes. I have to make calls to the people on the list that I have. I have to use the questions I have on the list, but I don't have to follow the order. Mr. Peters: Correct! That's right. Now, you may need a break every hour or so. When you need a break, please tell Alexia. She makes a note of when everyone takes a break. Tomas: OK. And who is Alexia? Mr. Peters: I'll introduce you to her when she comes back from her break. Now, you have to be here at 8.45 a.m. every morning because we start the calls at 9 a.m. You need to come at 8.45 because Alexia needs to give you the list of people to call for the day. Tomas: OK. Mr. Peters: It might be quite stressful on your first day. But don't worry. We are all here to help you. You may have more questions after you start work. If you do, then just come to my office. I'm usually busy, but I'll find time for you.

F Read the job advertisement. Then choose the correct answers. Architect wanted at ACC We are a family business of architects based in the center of Seattle. We are looking for an architect to join our team. We are a small company and we started our business ten years ago. Thanks to some great architects, we designed and built many of the great buildings in and around Seattle. Who are we looking for? An architect with experience designing apartments and small hotels. Somebody who is a team player and who likes working as part of a team. A person with experience managing small teams of people. What is the position? You will have to work here in the office in Seattle. You might have to travel to visit buildings in other cities in the area. You will have to dress formally most of the time, but you don't have to on Fridays, because we have 'jeans Friday'. You will have to work until 6 p.m. most days but you won't have to work on Friday afternoons. What can we offer you? At ACC you don't have to pay for your own car or for your lunch because we offer free lunch in our cafeteria and a company car. We also offer you free membership to a gym in the same building. You will have 22 days of vacation a year. You don't have to take this in the summer; you can take it whenever you want. 1 ACC is . A a small company B a large company C an International company 2 ACC wants a person with experience . A designing large hotels and managing big teams of people B designing large apartments and working on teams C designing hotels and apartments and managing small teams of people 3 This job . A is in Seattle with some possible travel B is always in the office in Seattle C is in Seattle some days and there is also a lot of travel 4 The architects have to . A wear formal clothes every day B wear formal clothes four days a week C wear informal clothes every day 5 ACC offers many things including . A lunch at a local restaurant every day B 22 days of vacation that you have to use in the summer C 22 days of vacation and a company car

EVOLVE LEVEL 2, Audioscript for Unit 10 Quiz B Mrs. Comas: Good morning. Mr. Gardener? Mr. Gardener: Hello. Good morning. I am here to ask you some questions about your office space. I am a germ expert and my job is to visit offices, to see if there are any dangers for your health. Mrs. Comas: Yes, please come through to our offices. You said in your email that you want to look around the office. Do you want me to do anything? Mr. Gardener: No, not at all. I need to look around the office and I may have some questions for you as we go around. Mrs. Comas: OK, fine. Please follow me. So, we have two offices. This is our main office space and we have a smaller office through the red door over there. Mr. Gardener: OK. And how many workers do you have in this main office? Mrs. Comas: We have the receptionist, the office manager and 15 call center workers. Today there are only 14 because one person is off sick. Mr. Gardener: And how many people work in the smaller office? Mrs. Comas: Well, I work in that office. And we have an accountant and an IT specialist. So there are three of us working in that office. Mr. Gardener OK, so that's 17 here and another three of you through there. Mrs. Comas: Yes, that's right. Mr. Gardener First, I'd like to look at the air conditioning system. Mrs. Comas: Here you are. Mr. Gardener: Now, when was the last time that you cleaned it? Mrs. Comas: I'm not sure... Mr. Gardener Air-conditioning systems recycle air and the germs in it, so it might be full of germs. Next, I'd like to have a look at one of the desks...

F Read the letter. Then choose the correct answers. Letters to the editor Dear editor, I am writing today to ask for advice about a fear that I have. I can't stand going to the dentist, because I went two years ago and I had a very bad experience. I had very bad toothache and the pain was killing me, so I went to the dentist. But I left feeling worse than when I went in. The dentist told me that I might have some pain, but she said that it was normal. So, I wasn't worried about it. For about two weeks after that, I had a fever and a sore throat. I also had a headache for most of the time, and my mouth hurt all over. I don't know if I was allergic to the penicillin, but the experience was so awful that I didn't want to ever go back again. This bad experience means that now I have a fear of dentists. I know I have to face my fear, but I can't stand thinking about the pain that I might have if I go again. I work as an accountant for a company and every two years we have to go to the dentist for an examination. I have to go to see the dentist next Friday. I know it probably won't be as awful as I think, but this is a very stressful situation for me. Jenna 1 Jenna didn't feel well she went to the dentist. A before B after C before and after 2 Last time Jenna went to the dentist, she . A didn't know it was going to hurt B knew it was going to hurt a little C knew it was going to hurt a lot 3 After going to the dentist, Jenna . A had a fever and a sore throat B had a fever and a headache C had a fever, a sore throat and a headache 4 Jenna . A goes to the dentist every year B goes to the dentist every two years C never goes to the dentist 5 She is writing because she go to the dentist soon. A has to B doesn't have to C might / 10 (2 points each)

EVOLVE LEVEL 2, Audioscript for Unit 11 Quiz A Nikki: Hey Mateo, where have you been? Mateo: What do you mean? Nikki: I called you three times this morning, and I sent you some WhatsApp messages. Where were you? Did you lose your cell phone? Mateo: No! I decided to try a digital detox challenge. Nikki: What's a digital detox? Mateo: It's when you try not to use as many digital devices as normal. So less cell phone, less tablet. Or even better, no cell phone and no internet. Nikki: What? Mateo: Yes, I turned my phone off yesterday when we finished classes and I didn't turn it on this morning. Nikki: What?? You're crazy! I've never turned my phone off. Well I turned it off when I took the flight last fall but I haven't done so since. I thought that you had blocked me!!! Mateo: What? Of, course not. I never block friends. I read this article about how it's really good to limit the amount of time we use our cell phones. Nikki: Oh, really? What a crazy idea to turn your phone off. Let's see... you miss calls, you don't know what is happening in the world, you make friends worry about you. Mateo: Hey, I'm sorry. But I do think it's good. I've downloaded this phone usage app that controls the amount of time that you can use the phone. Nikki: And? Is it any good? Mateo: I don't know, I haven't used it yet. I'm going to try this first idea of turning my phone off in the evenings first. Nikki: OK, great! So I can't call you in the evenings. Mateo: No! I'm only going to do it during the week for a few days... when we're studying.

1 The American Psychiatric Association say that you if you take more than three selfies a day you definitely have a problem. True / False 2 Some people have accidents from taking selfies in dangerous places. True / False 3 More women than men take selfies. True / False 4 You should look straight at the camera to take the perfect selfie. True / False / 8 (2 points each) F Read the article. Circle True or False for each statement. Let's talk about selfies Have you ever counted the number of selfies that you take in a day? According to the American Psychiatric Association, if you take more than three a day, you may have a problem. They say that any more than three selfies a day is too much, and that people who take more than six have a serious problem. Have you ever taken a selfie in a dangerous place? At the top of a building or a mountain? If you have, then you are not the only one. But every year there are accidents - and even deaths - from people who try to take selfies in dangerous places. Have you ever taken a selfie in Makati City in the Philippines? According to Time magazine, this the most popular place in the world to take a selfie. People like this selfie capital because of the skyscrapers and shopping malls. Who takes most selfies? Women usually take more selfies than men. The number of selfies we take changes in different cities of the world. The city where most women take selfies is Moscow. 82% of women in Moscow take selfies in comparison with 62% in New York. Do you know how to take the perfect selfie? According to experts, to take the perfect selfie you have to take the photo from an angle. So don't take the photo from in front, take it from the side. Also, your head has to be the right size in the photo. Not too big and not too small.

EVOLVE LEVEL 2, Audioscript for Unit 11 Quiz B Interviewer: Good morning. This morning we're going to be talking to two young people, Victor and Kerry, about their experiences with technology. ... Victor. Have you ever made a video that went viral? Victor: Well, I often upload videos onto Youtube, but they aren't usually very successful. I always tell my friends to like them and to watch them. I enjoy making them and that is the most important thing. Interviewer: What are the videos about? Victor: Well, the last one I made was about fitness. I love going to the gym and so I make videos about fitness. I don't know if other people like them as much as I do! Kerry: I have made a video that was very successful. It didn't go viral but the local newspaper called me and asked me for an interview. Interviewer: Really? Kerry: Yes. I play in a band with my friends and we have made a few songs. Last year we recorded two songs and we made a video of us. Interviewer: Wow, that's interesting.... OK, next question for you. Have you ever sent an email to the wrong person? Victor: Yes, I have! It was awful. Our teacher sent an email to the class to tell us about our homework. I had a lot of homework to do that week, and so when I got this email, I felt stressed. So I sent an email to my friend Jim. I told Jim that I didn't want to do the homework and that I was angry with the teacher. But... I didn't send it only to Jim. I sent it to the whole class and my teacher! Interviewer: Oh no! What about you, Kerry? Kerry: No, I've never sent an email to the wrong person like Victor. But I have sent emails and messages to people, and then five minutes later I think that the email or message was a mistake. You know, the message was too personal, or too angry, or just wrong. Interviewer: OK, and now for an interesting question. Have you ever found love online?

1 Victor / Kerry has made a video about fitness. 2 Kerry was / wasn't in the local newspaper. 3 Victor / Kerry sings in a band. 4 Victor sent an email to his teacher / his teacher and the rest of the class. 5 Kerry has / hasn't sent an email to the wrong person. / 10 (2 points each) A Listen to the radio program. Then read the sentences and circle the correct answers.

F Read the article. Then match the statements to points A-E. Digital Detox Challenge Have you ever gone out with friends and left your cell phone at home? Have you ever turned your cell phone off for 24 hours? If the answers to these two questions are no, then you should try the “digital detox challenge”. The idea of the digital detox challenge is to use less technology and to spend less time online. Here are some ideas: A Use settings Go to settings and block any emails you don't want to read, so that you get fewer emails. Now turn off notifications so you don't know when you get new emails or messages. Less information is more time away from your phone. B Make lists Make a list of all your devices. Of computers, tablets, cell phones that you use at work, school and home. Think about which ones you use the most and think about if you need to use all of them. Ask yourself, “Do I need them all?” If the answer if no, then maybe you don't need so many devices. C Download a phone usage app With this app you can limit the amount of time that you use your phone. You choose the amount of time and then your cell phone won't let you use it any more for that day. This really makes you think about how much you normally use your cell phone. D Use office hours You go home after work or after school and you can forget your place of work until 9 a.m. the next day. Do the same with your phone. If you can, turn it off at the end of your working day. Enjoy the quality time with your family. E Turn off your devices at night It is important for you to sleep, and people sleep better when there are no cell phones or computers in the bedroom. So, don't listen to music on headphones, or read on your tablet in the bedroom. 1 If you do this, you use your phone for a short time during the day. 2 If you do this, you get a better night's sleep. 3 If you do this, you don't know when you get emails or messages. 4 If you do this, you think about how many devices you have. 5 If you do this, you spend more time with your family. / 10 (2 points each)

EVOLVE LEVEL 2, Audioscript for Unit 12 Quiz A Rebecca: Have you ever travelled to another country, Jessica? Jessica: Yes, I have. Last year Scott and I got married and we went to Sri Lanka on vacation. Rebecca: Oh, wow! That sounds amazing. What was Sri Lanka like? Jessica: We loved it. Sri Lanka's a beautiful island. Rebecca: How big is it? Jessica: It's about the same size as the state of West Virginia. We went on a two-week trip around the island and we saw so many things. Rebecca: What did you do? Jessica: Well, we flew to Colombo and we stayed for four days in Colombo. We visited the stores and the cafés. It was amazing. Rebecca: And what did you like the most? Jessica: It's difficult to say because we did so much. After Colombo we went to Adam's Peak which is a very tall mountain. And we went to a national park to see the animals. We took a lot of buses and a lot of trains around the island. Rebecca: So, you traveled a lot. Were you tired? Jessica: No, because at the end of the vacation we stayed at a beautiful hotel on the beach. I think Scott liked the beach more than the other parts of the vacation! He loves to swim and we just relaxed on the beach and swam every day there. It's a really cool beach because it's between the cliffs and the ocean. Rebecca: It sounds perfect. Did you like the food? Jessica: Yes, we ate a lot of rice and curry. The food is very spicy because they cook with a lot of chilies. It was delicious. Rebecca: It sounds lovely. And what was the weather like? Jessica: Well, we went in July and it was very hot. Some days it rained because it was the rainy season, but most days it was boiling hot. I had to wear a sunhat all the time. Rebecca: I can imagine.

F Read the blog post. Then choose the correct answers. Community Gardens People who live in the center of a town or city often don't have a garden, or if they do, it might be very small. For people who can't grow their own fruit and vegetables, a community garden is a great place. A community garden is a garden which is used by a lot of different people who live near each other. People work together to grow fruit and vegetables, which are for all the people who use the garden. Sometimes community gardens are in villages and sometimes they are in cities. In the USA, American people started making community gardens in the 19th century. They planted fruit and vegetables in places between buildings and in school gardens. It was the perfect way to use empty land and they saved a lot of money. During the Second World War Americans grew 40% of their own food! Community gardens are fun and people enjoy them. People who live in apartments in cities sometimes don't know their neighbors. Sometimes old people are lonely because they have nobody to talk to. In a community garden people meet their neighbors and they talk. Usually people of all ages use the garden, and this can help children learn about where lettuce, potatoes and tomatoes come from. 1 What is a community garden? A A garden where people from different cities grow fruit and vegetables. B A garden where people go to buy fruit and vegetables. C A garden where neighbors grow fruit and vegetables. 2 Who uses community gardens? A Teachers and parents. B Neighbors of all ages. C Old people. 3 Why did people start community gardens in the USA? A Because they didn't have any gardens. B Because they didn't want to spend so much money on food. C Because there was a lot of empty land. 4 Where can you find community gardens? A In the country. B In the city. C In the country and the city.

EVOLVE LEVEL 2, Audioscript for Unit 12 Quiz B Reporter: Good morning, everyone. Today I am visiting a community garden here in Boston. It is a cold, foggy Saturday morning and I am freezing cold! But there are lots of people here this morning at the garden and they look like they are having fun. I'm going to talk to people, but first let me describe to you this amazing garden. Here in Boston there are about 200 community gardens and people tell me that there are probably about 100 more in school gardens. This is one of the 200 and I can see lots and lots of green plants, some fruit trees and some lovely big paintings which the children have painted. The biggest painting is a picture of the skyscraper in Boston and next to it is are mountains and a beautiful waterfall. Now let's talk to one of the neighbors... Excuse me, you look like you are having fun. Tell me, why do you come here? Mary: Hi. Yes, we love it! I am here with my husband Frank and our children. We come here every Saturday. Some days it's foggy like today, other days it's windy and rainy. But we still come! We meet our neighbors and we talk about what we've done during the week. The children play with the chickens or they paint. And we do some gardening and we eat some delicious fruit and vegetables. Look at these strawberries! Reporter: They look delicious. Sorry... What's your name? Mary: Mary. Reporter: Thanks Mary, and enjoy the rest of your morning.

F Read about the vacation. Then match each statement to the days. There is one extra. 2 weeks in Bali Day 1-4: You'll arrive in Ubud and spend two days exploring this beautiful town with its lovely restaurants and cafés. On day 2 you'll take a cycling trip into the hills behind Ubud, and if it isn't cloudy, you can take photos of the landscape. On day 3 you'll go walking in the rice terraces. This is an area where people grow rice, and you can learn about how they grow the rice. A taxi will pick you up and take you a small hotel in the hills. Day 4-5: You'll stay in the village in the hills for two days. Here you can meet the local people, eat the typical food and go walking in the green valleys. Day 6-7: You'll travel from the village to the Water Palace. This is a wonderful hotel in the hills which has statues and fountains in the gardens. Day 8-9: Lovina is on the coast and here you can go out in a boat to do some fishing. After the fishing you can relax on the golden beaches. Day 10-12: Munduk is a village in the mountains and it has waterfalls and lakes. Here you can enjoy the beautiful landscape. Day 13- 14. At the end of your vacation in Bali you'll stay in a small house on Balangan Beach. The beach is between some cliffs and the ocean, and here you can enjoy the sunny weather, relax and think about the wonderful things you have seen in Bali. 1 You stay in the mountains and you can see water that isn't the ocean. 2 You walk around the gardens of a hotel. 3 Here you can see cliffs, the ocean and the beach from where you stay. 4 You can learn about how the people grow food. 5 You can eat typical food with people who live there. A Days 1-4 B Days 4-5 C Days 6-7 D Days 8-9 E Days 10-12 F Days 13-14 / 10 (2 points each)

EVOLVE LEVEL 2, Audioscript for Unit Quiz 1A Simona: Hi Jane. Great to see you again! Coffee? Jane: Yes, please. Let's sit down over there at that table near the window. Simona: Hey. This place is nice. So how are you doing, Jane? How's school? Jane: Yes, all fine thanks. My new apartment is cool and my roommate is awesome. She is from a big family so her brothers and sisters visit very often. Here is a photo. Simona: Hey, that's a beautiful bag. Is it yours? Jane: Oh, thanks! No, it's not mine. It's my grandmother's. It's very special. It's over 50 years old! Look it is very big. There is my hairbrush, a water bottle and my keychain inside. Simona: Seriously? It's so beautiful. And hey, whose shoes are those? They aren't yours! Jane: No, that's right. They're my sister's. They belong to her, but I like them a lot. Uh? Look! She's right there! Let's hide behind the menu! Simona: Uh? Wow! Why? What's up? Jane: Shhh. These shoes belong to my sister. They aren't mine!! Let's get out of here. Run!!

F Read Marco's email to his sister Anna. Circle True or False for each statement. Dear Anna, How are you? It's great here in New York! I love the school. Let me tell you about my new friends. Vicky and Alice are two sisters from Italy. Alice is a student at school from Monday to Friday, but on weekends, she works in a big café downtown. Vicky is a student too. She goes to the beach on weekends. Their apartment is full of beautiful Italian clothes and shoes! Hiroko is Japanese. He is from Osaka and he's a student. He's my classmate. In his free time, he likes baseball. He is Alice's boyfriend. Sometimes we watch a game at the local field. Michel is from France. He is the grandson of a famous French chef! Michel is at my school too, but he isn't in my class. He's my roommate. Our dinners are always delicious. My job is to do the dishes! Our teacher is British but she lives in New York. She visits her family in London in the summer. She has a British driver's license, so she never drives in the USA. Hope to see you again soon! Best wishes, Marco 1 Marco is in New York. True / False 2 Alice and Vicky are close friends. True / False 3 Marco is in class with Hiroko. True / False 4 Hiroko is Marco's roommate. True / False 5 Their teacher is American. True / False / 10 (2 points each)

EVOLVE LEVEL 2, Audioscript for Unit 1 Quiz B Brian: Hi Jane. Great to see you again! How is your family? And how's the new school? Jane: My family are well, thanks. And the school is pretty good. It's my second day today. The teacher is friendly. I like her a lot. Brian: You're lucky! Mine is not friendly, but she's a good teacher. My classmates are great. They're so funny! Jane: Where are your classmates from? Brian: Some are from Japan, and some are from Europe such as France, Italy and Germany. Max is my roommate in the apartment. His family is from Berlin and he skypes home sometimes, so I see them on the computer. They are pretty friendly too. What about your classmates? Where are they from? Jane: The ones in my class are all from Mexico, like me. My roommate in the apartment is also my close friend, Elena. She is from Argentina. We talk about everything in Spanish! Brian, whose driver's license is that under the table? Brian: I don't know. Let's see. Oh! It's Max's driver's license! Look, that's his name and his photo! Jane: Oh, he's cute! Living in another country Some people move to another country to learn another language, and other people move to travel around the country and to meet people. It's a good idea to go somewhere where you have friends or family, so that you have people to get together with. The weather isn't something you should think about if you are going to be staying for a few months. There are a lot of jobs that people can do in different countries and some people only need a cell phone and a laptop for their work. You should think about if you prefer to work for a company, or if you prefer to work for yourself before you go. If you work for a company, you may meet more people, but if you work on your own, then you decide when and where you work. F Read the article. Circle True or False for each statement. Augmented reality and advertising What is AR? A lot of people love playing videos games on their tablets or laptops and most of these games use augmented reality or AR. What we see on the screen are digital images and not real things. Right now, some of the advertising that we see on TV or on online ads use AR. AR often helps to make better ads. It helps advertisers to sell us more than the object; with AR they can sell us an idea. How do companies use AR? Some examples of how AR is used in advertising: - In an ad with AR we can see the item we want to buy in the real world. When we see a traditional ad on the TV or in a magazine we see a photo of the product. If we use AR, we can see all around the product, in front of the product and behind it. - Ads that use AR can tell us more about the product they want to sell. They can tell us a story, and we all like listening to stories. The story can tell us why the product is better than the others. - Companies can use AR to take us on a tour of the store. We watch the ad and we can see inside the store and all the things to buy. This is more interesting than looking at photos of the store on the webpage. - Some companies use apps, and with the app we can see the AR. Why do companies use AR? AR is often cheaper for companies than traditional ads, and the ads they make for us are more attractive and more interesting. The future of advertising is changing. And fast. 1 Right now, AR is used a lot in video games. True / False 2 AR can help companies to sell ideas. True / False 3 AR tells us less about a product. True / False 4 AR can't show us inside a store. True / False 5 The writer thinks that we are going to see more AR in the future because it is more interesting than traditional ads. True / False / 10 (2 points each)

F Read the article. Then answer the questions. Saving the Ocean, Bracelet by Bracelet Look around you. You can probably see many objects made of plastic. Plastic is an important part of our lives, but each year about 8 million tons of plastic goes into our seas and oceans. In the future, there may be more plastic in the ocean than fish! This is not only a problem for creatures that live in the ocean; it's a problem for humans, too, because fish eat plastic and humans eat fish. So, what can you do to help? Well, if you buy a bracelet online you can help remove a pound of trash from the world's oceans. This is the idea of 4Ocean, a business which was started by two surfers, Andrew Cooper and Alex Schulze. They had their idea when they were surfing in Bali, Indonesia. Some fishermen were having problems moving their boats through the water because there was so much plastic. Andrew and Alex suggested that the fishermen use their nets to remove the plastic. But the fishermen said, 'We don't get paid to collect plastic; we get paid to catch fish.' The surfers saw a big problem and decided to do something. Their idea was the 4Ocean bracelet. Each bracelet that is sold helps to provide money to support a team of ocean cleaners. Since the company started, over 150 people have joined 4Ocean to work in many countries around the world. 4Ocean's first goal is to remove a million pounds of trash from the ocean and coasts. If you want to help, you can buy a bracelet and you can also work as a volunteer. There's too much plastic in the ocean and it's a big problem. However, if people work together by using less plastic and developing new ideas like the 4Ocean bracelet, then maybe we can really help save our oceans.. 1 What is the writer trying to do in this article? F Read the article. Then answer the questions. The Power of Influencer Marketing Companies don't always create advertising for everybody. They sometimes choose a specific group of people called “influencers.” Who are these influencers? Influencers are people or groups who might have an effect on other people's actions and opinions. Influencers are often famous, and they usually have thousands of people following them on social media like Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter. Using influencers to attract people's attention to a company's products is called “influencer marketing.” Why is it used? Advertising on TV can be very expensive, but if a company can get one influencer to like and talk about its product, then this product can be seen by lots of people. It is much less expensive to reach a few influencers than it is to reach everybody. Also, many people who follow influencers share things they like with their own friends and followers on social media, so news about a product can travel very fast. Why is it successful? Think about why you buy a product. Is it because you saw a commercial or because someone you know said it was good? We often buy products because our friends and family recommend them. In the same way, if an influencer that you trust recommends a product, you might try it. Are there any disadvantages? Companies may have to pay an influencer to talk about or show a picture of the product. But this cost is usually very little compared to the cost of a TV commercial, which can cost much more. So, if you want to sell more of your product, try influencer marketing! 1 What is the main idea of the article? A to explain why influencer marketing is bad for companies B to explain how individuals can get more followers C to explain what an influencer is 2 An influencer is someone A who follows people on social media. B who sells their own products on social media. C who can change the behavior and attitudes of others. 3 Influencer marketing A starts with a small group of people. B is a good way to get people to watch your commercials. C is not as cheap as TV advertising. 4 Which of the following does the writer suggest in paragraph 3? A Commercials are the best way to advertise. B Our friends and family like to do the same things as we do. C We may buy a product if someone we know says it is good. 5 What is a disadvantage about influencer marketing? A Companies may have to create pictures of the product. B An influencer might want to be paid. C It could cost much more compared to a TV commercial. / 10 (2 points each)

F Read the article. Then answer the questions. FROM ZERO TO HERO The American singer Katy Perry is known all around the world today, and some people think that she became famous suddenly. In fact, Perry experienced many challenges before getting the success she wanted. Katy Perry was born in 1984. Her real name is Katheryn Hudson. When she was a child, she listened to gospel music with her brothers and sisters. She started singing by practicing with her sister's cassette tapes and then performed the songs for her parents. Her family was poor, and she knew that she would have to work at being a successful singer. When she was 13, she was given a guitar and started performing songs she had written herself. In 1999, she took a risk by leaving high school to follow her dream of being a singer. She was only 15 years old. In 2001, her first album, Katy Hudson, came out. But only 200 copies were sold, and, soon after, the record company went out of business! She changed her style of music from gospel to pop music and moved to Los Angeles. In 2004, she got a contract with Columbia Records, started working on her second record, and also wrote songs with a band called The Matrix. But, before her record was finished, the record company ended her contract. Finally, in 2006, Perry was signed to her fourth record company, Capitol Music Group. That year she had her first successful song eleven years after getting her first guitar! Her album One of the Boys became a success around the world, and now she is one of the most successful female singers of all time. Katy Perry's story shows us that to be successful you don't need to be born rich or lucky. You can be successful by working hard and not giving up. So, if you have a dream, keep on trying! 1 What point of view does the writer use? A first person B second person C third person 2 Before 1999, Katy Perry A wrote songs with her brothers and sisters. B made money for her family by singing in public. C created and sang her own songs. 3 After she left school, Perry A finished a new record with Columbia records. B had several disappointing experiences. C performed a concert with a band called The Matrix. 4 In 2006, Katy A had a song that was popular in many countries. B wrote her first pop song. C bought her first guitar. 5 The main goal of the article is A to explain how Katy Perry wrote a successful song. B to show that success was not quick or easy for Katy Perry. C to suggest that if you want to become successful, it is better to change your name. / 10 (2 points each)

So, I set myself a goal of trying to talk to one girl every day. After a few weeks, I felt much more relaxed. I met my girlfriend this way, and we're probably going to get married. Haley: I couldn't do that. I'm not a confident person. How could I build my confidence, Ross? Ross: Well, some people say you should do one thing every day that makes you feel afraid. But if you do that, you may feel stressed doing things that aren't actually useful. If I were you, I'd start with little changes - for example, you could walk home a different way or go to a store that you've never been to. Betty: Haley, is there anything that you'd like to try but are afraid of? Haley: I'd like to set up my own company, but if I left my job and things didn't work out, I'd feel terrible, like I'd never be successful at anything, you know? Ross: But if you don't try, you'll never know. Haley: Good point. Formatted: Heading 2

F Read the article. Then answer the questions. The Power of No Imagine this situation. You are leaving work, and someone invites you to a birthday party the following day. You say yes. Later, you get home, and you are angry with yourself. You wanted to relax this weekend. You had other plans. Now you have to find a present and some nice clothes. In addition, you have to go to a party where you only know one person. Why didn't you say no? One reason for not saying no is that you might be afraid of making the other person unhappy. You want to be liked, and you don't want to hurt other people's feelings. But really you are telling yourself that your own feelings are not as important as the other person's feelings. Also, you might worry that if you don't say yes, you won't get a second chance. This is not true - life is full of opportunities. A third reason is that you might forget that there are options other than yes and no. For example, you can say you have to speak to someone else first. This gives you time to think about whether you want to say yes or no. Also, this means the other person is already prepared for the no and will be less disappointed. And finally, remember you can always change your mind. If you think you have made the wrong decision, contact the person who invited you. Explain that something has happened and that you can't go to their party. This is quite a normal thing that people do all the time. You can practice saying no all the time - for example, when people ask you for money or try to sell you things. Always say, “No, thank you,” and smile. And if you want to say yes - that's fine too! 1 What point of view does the writer use? A first person B second person C third person 2 The writer gives the example of the party A to show the problems you can have when you say yes to things. B to introduce the idea that life is full of opportunities. C to explain why very few people go to parties. 3 Some people say yes to things they don't want to do because A they are afraid of making a bad decision. B they want other people to like them. C they want to go to parties. 4 The writer suggests that instead of saying no, people should A always say yes because that will give them more opportunities in the future. B ask a friend to say no for them. C wait and think about the right decision to make. 5 What does the writer say about changing your mind? A It is not an unusual thing for people to do. B It is better to change a no to a yes than a yes to a no. C You can practice doing it with people who ask for money. / 10 (2 points each)

EVOLVE LEVEL 3, audioscript for Unit Quiz 12A Filename: EV_L3_U12_QuizA Jessica: I smile a lot. It's true. People see me with a smile on my face, and they think that I have the ideal life, that everything is just perfect. But I smile, not because I have an easy life, but because I know that when bad things happen, I can think about them in a positive way. I'll give you an example. We've all been on public transportation when there's been a problem and the bus or the train stops. When this happens, I see everyone getting really stressed - they start asking what the problem is and start worrying about how late they will be, and they're terrified about what their boss will say. I know there is nothing I can do about the situation, so I just take out my phone and listen to a podcast or some music and smile because I am either enjoying the music or learning something from the podcast. But my attention is not on the bad situation in the present or a possible bad situation in the future. Everyone loves worrying about the future! My husband gets really worried when we have people coming to visit. He spends a lot of time cleaning the house and spends lots of money on different foods and drinks. He is worried about the future. Will everyone like the food and our house? I help him clean the house, of course, but I try to enjoy the experience of preparing for our visitors. So how can you learn to be more positive? By the end of my talk, you will understand that enjoying the present is more important than worrying about the future. So stop worrying about when we'll have the coffee break, and look at this terrific picture of me when I was seven years old.

F Read the article. Then read the questions and choose the correct answers. Underwater Treasure Have you ever dreamed of finding hidden treasure? Imagine finding 300-year-old gold coins and other valuable things at the bottom of the sea. That is what happened in 2015 to Eric Schmitt. Eric was a boat captain. He and his family had a contract with 1715 Fleet-Queens Jewels, a Florida company that has permission to look for treasure in the area. Eric and his family usually didn't find anything, but on June 17 when Eric was moving sand with his hands, he was thrilled to see gold coins appearing between his fingers. At the time, Eric was only 1,000 feet from the coast and the coins were just 15 feet below the water. In total, Eric and his family found 52 gold coins, 40 feet of gold chain, and 110 silver coins and buttons - a magnificent collection worth over $1 million. One gold coin, called a Tricentennial Royal, was made for the Spanish king and was worth $500,000! Eric and his family had started looking for treasure in 2010, but this was the biggest collection they had ever found. Why was the treasure there? In 1715, a group of twelve boats were returning to Spain from Havana, Cuba. They sailed into bad weather as they were passing the Florida coast. Eleven of the ships, including the main ship, the Capitana, were damaged and sank. The gold and silver they were carrying sank with them. Since the discovery, Eric and his team continue to work in the area, hoping to find more of the Capitana's gold. They have found more silver coins and some buttons but nothing compared to the first treasure they found. 1 What is the writer's main purpose in writing this article? A to explain how you can find treasure B to tell a story about a Spanish ship C to describe an exciting discovery 2 What happened on June 17, 2015? C everything was made of gold. 4 In 1715, A twelve ships all sank to the bottom of the ocean. B a group of Spanish boats got lost on the way to Cuba. F Read the article. Then answer the questions. How Do Friends Become Friends? Your days may be filled with activities with lots of people, but are all those people really friends? They might just be people you know. The difference is that you can count on a friend. Whether you're happy or sad, your true friends are there for you. And when you have a problem, you talk about it with your true friends. A recent study shows several interesting things about friendship. There are a few important “ingredients” for real friendship. 1 Time! Time is a central ingredient to friendship. We have different types of friends. The two most obvious types are “close” friends and “casual” friends. Casual friends are the people we spend a little time with now and then. But sometimes a casual friend becomes a close friend, and the secret to that is spending time together. On average, it takes 90 hours for a casual friend to become a close friend. 2 Interests! If you're into football and a friend is into chess, it is possible that you'll become and stay friends. However, you have a better chance of a close friendship with someone whose interests are similar to yours. 3 Listening skills! Listening can seem like a small thing to offer, but it isn't small at all. People need to talk about their problems and successes with someone who listens carefully. And they need to be able to trust the person they talk with. So, be a good friend and listen at least as much as you speak. People often expect making friends to be easy, but it's actually a challenge. It's not enough for two people to like each other. A strong, serious friendship requires shared time, shared interests, and - perhaps more than anything - a good listening ear. 1 What is the main topic of the text? A free time B relationships C listening and speaking 2 A casual friend is A someone you've never met before. B someone you know but isn't a close friend. C the same as a close friend. 3 A close friend is A someone you share all your interests with. B someone you've spent a lot of time with. C an average person. 4 You're more likely to have a long friendship with someone if A you play chess with your friend. B you have a lot of problems. C you enjoy the same type of activities. 5 The main goal of the article is A to explain why we need friends. B to show why modern society is bad for friendships. C to describe how good friendships are made. / 10 (2 points each)

F Read the article. Then answer the questions. THE BENEFITS OF LIFE WITHOUT TV In 2014, Kate and Bill Moser left their jobs in Los Angeles and moved to a small town in the Midwest. They started a family and had two children. There's nothing very special about that, but the Moser family is a little unusual - they haven't owned a TV since they moved. The children have never seen a TV show except at friends' houses. Interestingly, no one in the family even wants a TV. But why? Bill Moser explains. We haven't had a TV in a long time, and we don't miss it at all. Here's why: 1. We've saved money because we don't pay a cable company, and our kids don't see commercials for toys and fancy clothes. Our little boy, Mikey, loves to repair damaged things he finds in the yard. He has already made two toy trains and a car out of trash. 2. Have you heard that the average American spends over five hours watching TV every day? We have a lot more time now that we're not watching TV. In fact, we've never read so many books! 3. My wife and I haven't had to go to the doctor's office for two years. That's because we spend most of our free time outdoors - hiking, cycling, and playing with our kids. I've already lost some weight! 4. Our children have never eaten pizzas, burgers, chips, candy, or any junk food because they don't see any commercials for it. Also, we have more time to cook, so we try new healthy recipes together. 5. I think we might be a little smarter now, too. Some studies have shown that watching TV can change the way your brain works. Kids who watch a lot of TV when they're very young often start speaking later. All good reasons to turn off the TV! 1 What is unusual about the Moser family? A They moved away from Los Angeles. B They have two children. C They don't own a TV. 2 Since they moved to the Midwest, the Mosers A have paid a cable company. B have lived in Los Angeles. C have started a family. 3 What has Mikey done? A He has made toys out of trash. B He has bought fancy clothes. C He has watched a lot of commercials. 4 Why haven't Mr. and Mrs. Moser had to go to the doctor's office? A Because they don't like doctors. B Because they have saved a lot of money. F Read the article. Then answer the questions. The Difference Technology Makes Can you imagine life without your devices? Probably not! Everything has changed since we got smartphones, laptops, and wi-fi. Some people say it's a bad thing. They say we spend too much time looking at our devices. We don't talk to each other enough. But is it all bad? I don't think so! My life is better because of technology. I have parents and grandparents who live in Ecuador, but I've lived in the US since 2005. That means we don't see each other very often - maybe only once a year. Then, one day, my parents bought their first modern laptop. Since that day, they've learned to use video calling. It feels outdated to call them on my phone these days. I just sit down at my computer, and there they are on my screen! Social media is another thing I really like. Sometimes in the past, I've felt sad about my friends back home. I want to know how they are and what they're doing, but they're far away and I can't see them. Now, every time I look on social media, I see pictures and news that my friends have posted, and they don't seem so far away. Apps are another thing I love about technology. I have a few instant messaging apps, and that means that my friends are always just one little message away, wherever they are and wherever I am. It can be in school, at home, at work, and even at the beach. Some people say technology keeps us apart. I don't agree - I think it brings us together! 1 The writer thinks that for him modern technology is A a bad thing. B a good thing. F Read the blog post. Then answer the questions. Pay Less! Everyone knows that vacations can cost a lot of money. There are flights to book, hotels and restaurants to pay for, and vacation souvenirs to buy, of course. So how can you have a cheap vacation? Here's the best advice on the internet. You should always check a few different websites because you might find better prices for hotels and flights. For cheap flights, try typing in early morning departure times, like 6 a.m., for example. Many people don't like to fly early in the morning or late at night, so you can also look at late-night arrival times. Arriving after midnight often makes the flight cheaper. Look for routes that aren't direct, too. You could fly cheaper if you take two planes instead of just one! If you're traveling alone, you should stay in a hostel to save money. Many hostels have small kitchens so you can cook food from the supermarket. They also often have books, games, wi-fi, and TV. Some hostels give you free food and free tours of the city. Hostels are great places to make new friends, too. Use your apps! There are a lot of apps that can help you get good prices on hotel rooms. You just open the app each morning and look for the best prices. And my best advice ... I'd eat street food! It's delicious, easy to find, and it only costs a dollar or two. You could eat a different dish every day and still save money. Oh, and don't buy water. Take a water bottle with you. Water's free! Your turn: how do you save money on vacation? Tell us here. 1 What is the blog post about? F Read the article. Then answer the questions. What Frightens You? The world is full of frightening things. Spiders, snakes, nighttime, monsters, tall buildings, dentists, horror movies - all these things make some people frightened. So, why do we have these fears, and how should we deal with them? Fear is fascinating. The first question - why do we have these fears? - is simple. It's your brain making you frightened! Fear is a feeling, and like all feelings, it's your brain that creates it. It's your brain's way of facing danger. Your brain's job is to get you ready for one of two things: either you run away from the danger, or you face the danger and fight it. It's that simple. You don't decide to be afraid. However, you can develop some control over your fears. You can learn how to control your reaction to frightening situations. Think about all the people who do scary jobs. Doctors, airplane pilots, police officers, and firefighters all do or see scary things every day. They can't just run away from their jobs, so they learn to deal with the fears. How do they do that? Well, they practice over and over again until they can look at a scary situation and do what they need to do. You can do the same. Imagine this situation. You're scared of spiders. You're in bed one night, and suddenly you're shocked to see a huge black spider on the floor beside your bed. You think you're going to scream, but no sound comes out of your mouth. You can't move in case the spider runs towards you. Let's think about this: what are you going to do? You could call someone and ask them to come and take the spider away. But that isn't a very good solution to your problem. What you should do is try to understand spiders, get to know them, learn to like them even. First, practice looking at pictures of spiders on the internet. They can't hurt you on the internet! When you can look at them without getting too scared, go to a zoo and see some real ones. If you practice a lot, you're going to realize one day that spiders aren't scary at all. Next week on What Frightens You?, we're posting some advice on fear of flying. Come back and check the site then. 1 What is the purpose of this article? A It's to tell a story. B It's to give people information. C It's to make people frightened. 2 A fear is A something you imagine. B a feeling your brain makes. C a type of spider. 3 The article says you A can learn to manage your fear. B can't understand fear . C should be scared of many things. 4 The article says one way of controlling fear is A to get on the internet. B to practice being a doctor or firefighter. C to practice facing your fear. 5 The article uses spiders as A an example of a common fear. B a way of scaring the reader. C a description of a real danger. / 10 (2 points each)

F Read the interview. Then answer the questions. LOST AND FOUND Meet Levi. He works at Back Bay Train Station in Boston. He deals with all the things that people lose or find on the trains and in the station every day. We asked Levi a few questions. Do you like your job? I love my job. I meet so many people. Just last week, I spoke to over 300 customers. I work 5 days a week, so that was at least 60 people a day. It's terrific to see how grateful people are when you give them back the stuff they lost. One day, in 2005, when I was working at New York's Penn Station, a woman arrived at my office with a big bunch of flowers for me. She just wanted to say thank you. How do you locate the people who have lost their stuff? Usually they come to me. They know they've lost, for example, their purse. They come to the office and tell me what they lost. They give me the date and the train they were on. And then I take their contact information. When we find the item, we give them a call. What do people lose and find most often? Oh, that's easy! Phones. Phones, phones, phones! Last week, I was looking through some boxes when my coworker asked me how many phones we had. We had 173 phones. I'm not kidding. But, you know, we have on average at least 350 items lost and found a week, everything from keys to laptops to kids' toys. Why phones? Well, I guess it's because people keep them in their pockets, and they fall out and drop on the floor. I met this guy the other day. He searched the whole train for his phone. After an hour, he still couldn't find it. Do you want to know where it was? In his pocket! What's the strangest thing someone's - found on a train? You're not going to believe this - a wild turkey. I guess the passenger didn't want to take care of it!. 1 How many lost phones were in Levi's office when they counted them? A 173 B 350 C 60 2 Does Levi enjoy his job? A No, he doesn't. F Read the student's essay. Circle True or False for each statement. My Dream World Let's imagine a clean new world, a world where there's almost no trash. How would that happen? I see five things that might make our world a better place to live. 1. People recycle everything they use. If something can't be recycled, no one buys it. All the trash cans in towns and cities are almost empty. If a child drops a piece of trash, several people run to pick it up. If the streets are beautifully neat and clean, they will stay neat and clean. 2. The air everywhere is healthy, clean, and fresh. There's very little smoke in the sky because there are very few factories. People are happy and healthy. Animals and plants are also healthy because the land is clean and green again. 3. When people build new houses, they use wood, not concrete. A lot of the houses are in open green spaces where kids can play safely and adults can exercise. 4. There are almost no traffic jams ever because almost all of the people who live here travel by bike or on foot. If someone wants to own a car, they buy a small car that doesn't pollute. F Read the article. Then answer the questions. My Manhattan Today, the island of Manhattan is home to more than 1.5 million people. We live in a place where 23% of the population drive a car noisily (and sometimes dangerously) on the streets. The city is very noisy. In a lot of the open spaces, the noise is loud enough to damage your ears. If people don't try to change this situation, we will be in a lot of trouble! There are a lot of traffic jams because the only way in and out of Manhattan is either over a bridge or through a tunnel. If people start using public transportation more, the air pollution will get better. The biggest green space in Manhattan is Central Park. It's 1.317 square miles. This gives people some land where they can exercise and get away from the big concrete buildings. Incredibly, more than 230 different kinds of birds live in Central Park. If you go there early on a summer morning, you'll hear them singing beautifully in the trees. There are only a few other green spaces in Manhattan. Things are getting a little better now, but if we want clean air in the future, we will need to switch to electric cars. Manhattan is my home, and I want to help fight these problems. If we all fight together, it will be a beautiful place in the future. 1 What specific piece of information does the writer give about Central Park? A It's a place for people to exercise. F Read the article. Then read the questions and choose the correct answers. Life as an Extra Many people dream of working in movies or on television. Some people do this, but they are not famous and are usually only on the screen for a few seconds. These people are the “extras,” the actors you see behind the main actors. They might be part of a crowd or someone working in an office scene. So what is it like to be an extra, and is it a good way to get into movies? We spoke to Jon Jefferson, who has spent 30 years working as an extra. 'When I started, I thought it would be a good way to earn some extra money, but the pay was not as good as I thought and I had to pay for my transportation to reach the place where they were filming. Another problem is that the work is not very regular. You never know when a movie studio will call you. 'A typical day involves a very early start and a lot of waiting. You should bring a good book, as you can't listen to music on the movie set. In fact, you can't make any noise at all! The weather can be a problem - you may find yourself standing in the cold for hours or wearing a large costume on a hot day. 'Of course there are good things too - you learn all about how a movie is made, which is the reason I still do it. You also get free food on the movie set. But the most exciting moment is afterward when you see yourself on the big screen. But don't be an extra if you want to become a professional actor. The director won't suddenly see your face and choose you for their next movie!' 1 What is the writer's main purpose in writing this text? A to explain what an extra does B to help young actors to earn extra money C to find an extra for his next movie 2 What can a reader learn about in this text? A how much money you get for working as an extra B the advantages and disadvantages of being an extra C how to become a professional actor 3 What does Jon Jefferson say about his first experience of being an extra? A The movie studio called him at a strange time. B The transportation to the movie set was very expensive. C He was surprised by the amount of money he received for the work. 4 Jon says that a normal day working as an extra might include A doing nothing for long periods of time. F Read the article about internships. Circle True or False for each statement. Internships When you are a student, you want to get a job but you might not have experience. Unfortunately, all the good jobs require experience. So how can you get experience if no employer will hire you? One solution is to do a summer internship. This is when someone works for a company or organization in order to get experience in a particular type of work. Interns often receive no money for their work. If they do receive a salary, it is usually very low. So, why would you work for nothing or almost nothing? Well, the main reason is to get experience in the career you're interested in. This experience will look great on your résumé. Another reason is to make contacts in your chosen profession. If your coworkers see that you can do good work, they might recommend you to a colleague at another company. And if the managers like the way an intern works, they sometimes offer the intern a job with a salary when the internship finishes. If you are working without a salary, you will probably have to find another job to pay for your food and rent. Students often work in bars and restaurants. If you are doing your internship in another country, this is an excellent way to improve your language skills. One result of doing an internship is that you may discover that the profession you are in isn't as interesting as you thought. This means that when you return home, you can focus your attention on something different. That's why they call it a learning experience! Clearly, internships can be a great way of exploring the world of work. They provide excellent learning experiences that you don't have to pay for as well as offering opportunities to develop helpful new relationships. 1 Students doing internships are never paid for their work. F Read the article. Circle True or False for each statement. 1 The idea for Velcro was inspired by something in nature. True / False 2 George De Mestral invented Velcro right after walking with his dog. True / False 3 Dr. Spencer Silver decided in 1968 to invent the post-it note. True / False 4 Frank Epperson got the idea for popsicles from a young child. True / False 5 The writer is surprised by the everyday objects which came from a simple idea. True / False / 10 (2 points each) Invented by mistake! Amazingly many of the everyday items we use were invented by accident. Yes! By accident. Not all inventions are carefully planned. Some examples of accidental inventions include Teflon, saccharin, cornflakes, popsicles, post-it notes, Velcro, and safety glass. Let's look at Velcro as an example. Most of us use Velcro every day and take it for granted? But it was invented quite by chance. A man named George De Mestral, an electrical engineer, was walking his dog one day. Returning from the walk he noticed that the dog had a bur, a dry grass seed, stuck to his hair. He examined the phenomenon and realized that the bur had many tiny hooks. After experimenting with nylon, De Mestral eventually invented Velcro. Next time you reach for a post-it note to jot down a message or a reminder, think about how these useful like pieces of paper were invented. In 1968 Dr. Spencer Silver, a scientist from the US, made a glue which should have been stronger than it was. Dr. Spencer tried for five years to patent his glue but without success. Then one day a friend of his, Art Fry, decided it would be a good way of marking his place in the hymn book he used to sing in a choir. From that, Post-its were born! Finally, let's look at popsicles. These were invented by chance when one cold night an eleven-year-old boy accidentally left a glass of flavored juice outside his house on the porch. The next day the juice had frozen. This young boy, named Frank Epperson, went on to patent the idea and sell popsicles when he was older. Sometimes the best ideas begin with a blunder!

F Read the article. Circle True or False for each statement. 1 The writer of the article worked hard at college from the day he started. True / False 2 Soft skills are not skills that you study but skills that you acquire. True / False 3 The writer thinks that soft skills are necessary to be a manager. True / False 5 The writer suggests that sports and clubs should be listed on college degrees. True / False / 10 (2 points each) The importance of soft skills When I was choosing my college major, I never stopped to think about whether it would impress potential future employers. I was focused on being an undergraduate, joining societies, and getting in the best dorm. Once I had left home, my parents let me do what I wanted. I didn't really start worrying about grades until I was well into my second year and only in the last year did I start to think about the final degree. I think my experience is fairly typical. However, nowadays employers are looking for more than just good college grades and more than a degree. The world of employment is changing rapidly, and employers now look for candidates with soft skills. Soft skills are highly valued in today's workplace, and I think it's clear why. Soft skills do not come from academic subjects. They are not skills we learn from a teacher. Rather, they are the skills we need in order to perform well in our job and as part of a team. For example, problem-solving-the skill of being able to think creatively when resolving problems-is a soft skill. And time management-the skill of being able to organize your own time efficiently. If you stop to think about the jobs we do, it's clear that soft skills are very relevant for the workplace. Managing a team of people requires both good communication skills and good people skills, such as being understanding, being encouraging, and working as part of a team. I predict that in the future the importance of college degrees will change as we hear more about the value of soft skills among employers. I'm not suggesting that students should stop studying at college, but I do think doing other activities, like drama or playing sports, will help them develop these valuable soft skills.

F Read the article. Circle True or False for each statement. 1 False memories explain why we forget things in our daily life. True / False 2 A false memory might remember part of an event. True / False 3 Psychologists think they know the cause of false memories. True / False 4 Childhood amnesia is a new phenomenon. True / False 5 Children have a better memory for past events at the age of 3 than at 13. True / False / 10 (2 points each) Memories False memories Many of us go about our life on auto-pilot. We do everyday tasks so automatically that we don't have to think about what we're going to do next. We may think we have done something, like put the milk back in the refrigerator, but in reality we haven't. This is one type of false memory. But there are other types that psychologists are interested in. False memories are things that we think happened to us but they didn't. They can be partial or full. A partial false memory is when we have a vague memory of an event where we remember some details but not all. A full false memory is when we can clearly recall all the details and the memory is vivid, even though it didn't happen. Typically, false memories are simply memories about everyday events. Experts still don't know how or why this phenomenon exits. Childhood amnesia This is a concept that Sigmund Freud first referred to. Nowadays, this term is used by psychologists to refer to the fact that children before adolescence easily forget events that have happened in their recent past. However, research shows that up until the age of 3, children have an excellent memory of past events. The same research also shows that after the age of 3, as children get older, their long-term memory of childhood events gets worse, and they remember less.

F Read the article. Circle True or False for each statement. 1 Your brain gets its best exercise doing college work. True / False 2 Contemporary pop songs can be used to study things like historical dates. True / False 3 Taking time to relax is important when preparing for exams. True / False / 10 (2 points each) Memory hacks It's easy to take our memory for granted. We all know that we should take care of our bodies, but what about our minds? Our brains can benefit for some extra attention. Consider these suggestions for keeping your memory in shape. Put your brain to the test Just as your body needs to exercise, so does your brain. Give it some exercise with some kind of test. It doesn't have to be like doing work for college; it can be something more fun. Try sudoku, the number game that's on a nine-by-nine grid. There are lots of brain teasers you can find online for you to test yourself with. Use the power of melodies Studies show that music can help concentration. It has the power to relax your mind and your body and put your memory in better shape. You can find many raps and songs online that people have created using content that you need to memorize. Historical dates, the plots of a story... it can all be put to music. Relax Exams are a stressful time and not relaxing for anyone. If you can find the way to relax your mind, you'll find that memorizing and understanding your work is easier. Try meditation or swimming as great ways to relax. Do you have moments of feeling that your brain is full to capacity? Take a break, take a walk, call a friend. It's amazing what can happen when you switch off for a few minutes. Use memorization techniques There are many, so find one that works for you. Mnemonics is an example. Take the first letter of every word you want to memorize and use the letters to make a sentence. For people who have a visual memory, mind maps work great. Writing down all the main ideas on one page is helpful to those who need to “see” their concepts. The important thing is to keep your brain active and repeat, repeat, repeat. Practice, as they say, makes perfect.

When people get involved with a community project like gardening, they connect with each other and are usually very appreciative of the experience. Community gardening is a way of helping out the community, and at the same time taking part in something meaningful. If you are thinking of starting a community garden in your town, here are some steps you can take. 1 Identify a need Find out if similar projects already exist in your area. If not, then think about who your garden is for. Remember that gardening can be enjoyed by all ages and abilities. 2 Find growing space There may be unexpected opportunities for a growing space in your area. Check with your local government about available land that can be used as a growing space for your garden. 3 Choose your land The land must be watered on a regular basis, so make sure there is a steady source of water. You will need to lease the land from the owner. Leases might be given for months or years, so check the agreement carefully. 4 Plan your garden Think about the size of the plots of land. Gardening plots can be divided evenly so that everyone has the same size, or it can be divided into various sizes. Each plot must be separated from the one next to it in some way so that people have access to their plot. 5 Tell people about the community garden People in your area need to be made aware of your community garden, so be sure to advertise. If word gets around, you may be lucky enough to be given donations for your garden from local businesses. Happy gardening!

F Read the article. Circle True or False for each statement. 1 Digital tools make running a business easier than it used to be. The digital age has changed the type of marketing that companies do. In addition to traditional marketing, companies need to have a social media presence that includes great blog posts. If you are new to blogging, you may not know how to start or feel pressured to do as well as other great bloggers. How can you compete with such great ideas and clever writing? Don't worry. Here are some ideas to show just how easy it can be. 1 Pick a topic that you believe in and which will interest people. Write about something you are passionate about. Learn from experienced bloggers about what makes a good (and bad) blog post. 4 Remember that quality is better than quantity. Read and re-read your blog before posting it. When I write, I always ask myself the same question: “Can I say the same thing in fewer words?” If the answer is yes, then make it shorter to make it better.

A room escapes B karaoke C cooking class 3 Which activity can be changed to be more fun? A room escapes B karaoke C cooking class 4 Why does the writer think that team-building activities are needed? A They allow people to be creative. B People enjoy doing them, and they are then happier in their work. C People need to socialize, and this is a way of creating friendships. / 8 (2 points each) Fun corporate team-building ideas Office work can be tiring. Busy schedules and long office hours can be draining on your staff. This is why it is important to keep all employees feeling motived and excited about their work. You as a manager should make sure that your workers have time off from work so that they can find the perfect balance between work and downtime. If we all had perfect jobs, they would always be fulfilling, and our employees would always have a perfect balance of hard work and fun. But as we all know, life is not always like we want it to be. Here are some fun ideas that you can use to spice up the work day, help people to relax from their work commitments, and chill out or just have fun. Remember, happy workers means a happier workplace for everyone. 1 Room escapes Teams of people work together to solve a mystery or puzzle within a room or several rooms. This is a very popular team-building activity that brings people together. Teams have to compete with each other, so you might not to want to do this if you have very competitive staff. 2 Karaoke night If you thought that karaoke was only for the sociable people in the company, you would be surprised to know that almost everyone enjoys a karaoke. People love to sing, and this is one way to get your staff to take time off from their 9 to 5 work. 3 Cooking class If you have creative workers on your team, then this would be a great idea for them. Making dishes together requires creativity, and cooking is something that people can do in teams. To make it more fun, you can choose a single ingredient that people must use in their cooking. Then have a taste test to vote on the best dish.

F Read the article. Then complete the notes below with words from the text. • The writer describes two types of twins: 1 and 2 . • The percentage of twins in the general population was about 3 % a few decades ago. • The writer doesn't consider her look as an adult 4 to her sister's. • The writer and her sister decided to choose the same 5 after graduating from college. / 10 (2 points each) Being a twin Twins, as we all know, are two babies produced by one pregnancy. When they develop from the same egg, they are usually considered “identical” and have almost all the same characteristics. (Scientists have discovered, though, that they are not “exactly” the same.) When they develop from separate eggs, they are usually considered “non-identical” and might look quite different. Although the number of twins in the US has been increasing - from fewer than 2 in every 100 births in 1980 to more than 3 in 2016 - it is still relatively low. So people still seem very curious about twins: What is it like to be so similar to another person? How does it feel to have a look-alike? For me, it is always a little difficult to answer those questions, since I have only known life as a twin. My sister Claudia and I are identical twins. The likeness between us is very strong, and our features and build are pretty similar. In fact, when we were children, we sometimes had fun pretending we were the other at school, just to confuse people. But nowadays, for example, we each tend to wear very different styles and I would say we have pretty distinct tastes in clothes. However, we do sometimes think in similar ways as well. For instance, when Claudia and I graduated from high school, we both decided to go to the same college and eventually do the same job. Some people suggested that lack of confidence or of personality caused us to make such decisions. But that is not true. We both sincerely wanted to follow the same career path. All things considered, though, I wonder whether my relationship with Claudia is actually much different from that between brothers and sisters who are very close. Don't they also have so many things in common and often share the same views on life?

F Read the article. Then answer the questions. 1 What is the main idea of the article? A A well-designed website should be unique. B There is no way to improve on existing website design. C Good website design draws lessons from what already works. 2 What is the intention of the 3 click rule? A To provide users with only essential information. B To help users move around a website efficiently. C To prevent users from getting bored and leaving the website. 3 What does the writer say about a website's home page? A It should have links to all other pages of the website. B It should be the best designed page of the website. C It should only contain the most important information. 4 Which of the following statements would the writer most likely agree with? A Users expect all websites to be the same. B Users want websites to be new and interesting. C Users want websites to feel familiar and easy to use. / 8 (2 points each) Three Rules for Great Web Design Building a great website can be an intimidating task. With so many websites out there, how do you make sure yours gets noticed? Many web designers feel pressure to make their website unique, but being too unique can be a recipe for failure. It turns out that most successful websites share some common characteristics. So the challenge of successful web design is not to come up with a totally new design, but rather to identify the features that make a website successful and make sure they are in your design. As John D Rockefeller once said, “The secret to success is to do the common thing uncommonly well.” In this post we'll examine what makes a great website. The 3 Click Rule One common characteristic of most successful websites is that they are easy to navigate. Users don't want to spend a lot of time navigating your site. They want to get where they need to go - fast. The more time a user has to spend on your site trying to find what they are looking for, the more likely they are to leave your site. In general, it should take a user no more than 3 clicks to do anything. Whether they are trying to buy a product, contact customer support, or post a review, make sure users can accomplish it in no more than 3 clicks. Less is More Many web designers feel pressure to make the most of their website's home page. That can be a mistake. A home page that is too crowded with information can chase users away from your site. Identify the information that is most essential to your website. Put that on your home page - and nothing else. Do the expected Most good websites put certain features in the same basic places. The link to the user's shopping cart is almost always in the upper-right-hand corner. Links to social media are generally in the bottom left. When important features like these are not in the places users expect them to be, users get frustrated and will leave your site. Don't move away from these standard practices.
